title: Correct I₁ calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly compute I₁ = 1005 mA using parallel circuit analysis for terminals a-b.

title: Correct I₂ calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly compute I₂ = 205 mA using parallel circuit analysis for terminals a-c.

title: Correct U calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly compute U = 21 V using series circuit analysis for terminals a-d.

title: Parallel voltage equality
description: Important Criteria: Student applies voltage equality across parallel branches when analyzing ammeter configurations.

title: Current summation at junction
description: Important Criteria: Student correctly sums branch currents to find total ammeter range in both configurations.

title: Series voltage addition
description: Important Criteria: Student adds voltage drops across R₃ and galvanometer correctly for voltmeter range.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Student maintains consistent units (mA, V, Ω) throughout calculations.

title: Confusing parallel configurations
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly identifies which resistors are in parallel for different terminal connections.

title: Significant figure errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student makes arithmetic errors in current/voltage calculations leading to incorrect final values.
